description: Authority on Budget - Professional minimalism for solo real estate brokers in Mumbai, Pune, Thane
brandPromise: Help solo brokers look established and trustworthy without expensive design.

painPoints: Lose credibility competing with big agencies
Need professional appearance without corporate overhead
Trust-building is critical in real estate

keyMessages: 20+ years of expertise. Personal attention. No middlemen.
hinglishExamples: Direct broker से बात करो। Sab kuch transparent।
Apke dream property। Personal service। Expert guidance।
RERA certified। 20+ years experience। Trust guaranteed।
coreMessages.voiceGuide: Say what you mean, no fluff. Honest about process and pricing. Show knowledge. Not corporate, not casual.

primary.name: Navy
primary.usage: Headlines, CTAs, primary buttons, main UI elements

accent.name: Green
accent.usage: Success states, deal closed indicators, positive actions

colors.palette: Navy + Blue + Green with neutral grays. Minimalist, professional, trustworthy. No additional colors allowed.
colors.colorRestriction: Use ONLY Navy (#0F3A66), Blue (#1E40AF), Green (#22C55E), and neutrals. No other colors.

designPrinciples: 60% Whitespace Minimum - Every design should have significant breathing room
Minimalist Approach - Remove unnecessary elements, focus on clarity
Trust-First Design - RERA badge always visible, testimonials with names
Direct Communication - Short, clear copy, no jargon, Hinglish-friendly

rera.styling: Navy background, white text, 60px height minimum

testimonials.requirement: Include full names and real photos

experience.placement: Prominent, hero section or near RERA

aiGenerationPromptTemplate.basicTemplate: Create a [CREATIVE TYPE] for RealtyFlow, a real estate broker brand targeting solo agents in Mumbai/Pune. examples.instagramPost: Create an Instagram post (1080x1080px) for RealtyFlow. Navy background with white text. Minimalist design with 60% whitespace. Message: 'Direct Broker. Transparent Process.' Use Poppins font. Include green accent. Hinglish-friendly tone.
